title.original: PAT: Accelerating LLM Decoding via Prefix-Aware Attention with Resource Efficient Multi-Tile Kernel
title.zh: PAT：通过前缀感知注意力与资源高效的多分块内核加速 LLM 解码
title.en: PAT: Accelerating LLM Decoding via Prefix-Aware Attention with Resource Efficient Multi-Tile Kernel

inclusion_reason.zh: PAT 将共享前缀打包、多 tile kernel、多流执行、KV 切分和在线归并封装为 vLLM 可插拔解码后端。
inclusion_reason.en: PAT packages shared-prefix packing, multi-tile kernels, multi-stream execution, KV splitting, and online merge as a pluggable vLLM decode backend.

abstract.zh: PAT 通过 pack-forward-merge 执行范式利用服务请求的层次化共享前缀：先按前缀打包查询，再用多 tile kernel 和多流并行计算，最后在线 softmax 归并。
abstract.en: PAT exploits hierarchical shared prefixes through a pack-forward-merge execution pattern: queries are grouped by prefix, processed with multi-tile and multi-stream kernels, then merged with online softmax.

problem.zh: 解码注意力反复从显存加载相同系统提示、工具模板和 RAG 前缀，固定 tile 又让不同 KV 长度的请求造成片上资源空洞。
problem.en: Decode attention repeatedly loads identical system, tool, and RAG prefixes, while fixed tiling leaves on-chip resources idle for uneven KV lengths.

approach.zh: PAT 按共享前缀聚合查询以复用 KV，针对不同形状选择多个 tile，结合多流转发与 KV 切分填补资源气泡，再低开销归并结果。
approach.en: PAT groups queries by shared prefix to reuse KV, selects multiple tiles for shape diversity, combines multi-stream forwarding with KV splitting to fill bubbles, and merges outputs cheaply.

system_design.zh: 请求前缀分析器生成 pack，forward 层调度定制多 tile kernel 和 CUDA 流，必要时切分 KV；merge 层以在线 softmax 恢复每个请求输出，并以插件接入 vLLM。
system_design.en: A prefix analyzer builds packs, the forward layer schedules custom multi-tile kernels and streams with optional KV splitting, and online-softmax merge restores per-request outputs through a vLLM plugin.

key_results.zh: 真实与合成负载上，PAT 相比先进注意力 kernel 降低解码注意力时延，并在相同服务配置下改善每输出 token 时间。
key_results.en: On real and synthetic workloads, PAT reduces decode-attention latency against advanced kernels and improves time per output token under the same serving configurations.

limitations.zh: 缺少共享前缀时 pack 开销难以摊薄；前缀识别、KV 元数据和多流竞争会增加系统复杂度，收益也随请求长度分布变化。
limitations.en: Without substantial prefix sharing, packing overhead is hard to amortize; prefix metadata and stream contention add complexity, and gains vary with the request-length distribution.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
